name: Tarrant County, TX
findings: Tarrant County has 5,539 nonprofit organizations. 1,979 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,527 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Tarrant County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few political organizations list membership
observations.text: 11 political organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 44 would.

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through political groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Few research and think tank organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 7 research and think tank organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 29 would.

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through research and think tank groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Tarrant County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 95 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 569 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 569 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
